name: Mate's Education Pvt Ltd
short_bio:
[

Mates International Education and Visa Services

,

Mate’s Education Pvt. Ltd is one of the pioneer education consultancies of Nepal that helps Nepali students obtain “Admission & Student Visa” to go to different countries, mainly Australia, Canada, UK, and New Zealand. What makes us unique is our ‘equal support’ to those returning to settle back in Nepal by grabbing the new career opportunities or unique business startup ideas. Hence, we are here to help you while going abroad to Learn to Achieve your dream, Earn the Recognition of your successful dignity and even if you wish to Return to Reflect your education, experience, and expertise in Nepal. Abroad Study Plan is not like reading one book or watching one movie or visiting your favorite place for leisure activities. More specifically, it’s not a matter of short span of time.

,

Instead, it’s a matter of your whole life which is based on your one particular ‘action’ that decides ‘what kind of life’ you will live ahead as consequences. In short, Abroad Study Plan is the “The Transition Phase” of your life which is based on your today’s action and that action is – Choosing the right consultancy.

,

There are thousands of education consultancies in the market and most of them were, perhaps, born yesterday. Nothing wrong with that, but if your whole Life is going to depend on that Consultancy and their Counselors, you should always choose the one that has a History, the Experience, The Team and the one that can ‘Assure’ your future in abroad or even when you return to Nepal. Like we said, we are here to assist you go and here to assist you return – as your Guide & as your Mate. But we are here in the whole journey of your lifetime.

,

Mates an educational consultancy, moreover an organization in itself is taken as an epitome in the field of abroad studies. The services rendered by this organization is considered as the reliable one which has made numerous students climb the staircase of Mates.

]

Kangaroo Education Foundation Pvt. Ltd. is in the Consultancy business since 2001. It is one of the best educational institutes in Kathmandu. Kangaroo KEF has attended to many students, erased all their confusions, answered all their questions and queries, enhanced their confidence-level so that they become equipped for studying further and in return, received abundant thanks from the students who received our services and did tremendously well in abroad.   • Assistant on University Application

name: York International Educational Consultancy Pvt. Ltd
short_bio:
[

The Ministry of Education, Science and Technology (MoEST) has officially published the complete list of educational consultancy institutions that have successfully completed their renewal process for fiscal year 2082/83.

,

The ministry has urged students and parents to carefully verify the specific services any given consultancy is authorised to provide before enrolling or paying fees. Approved services range widely across the sector:

,

Consultancy firms are simultaneously reminded that they may only operate within the scope of services for which they hold explicit approval. Operating outside approved service categories is a direct violation of MoEST regulations and may result in cancellation of registration.

,

The complete directory of renewed consultancies for FY 2082/83, along with the formal gazette notice and service-category breakdowns for each firm, is available on the official MoEST website. The issuing authority is the Educational Consultancy Certification Branch, Singha Durbar, Kathmandu.

,

Nepal sends tens of thousands of students abroad each year — primarily to Australia, Japan, Canada, the United States, and various European nations. The education consultancy sector has at times been marked by misinformation, unregistered operators, and excessive fee charging, making this official transparency measure especially significant for families navigating the process.

,

By publishing a verified roster of cleared firms, MoEST gives students a reliable reference point to cross-check before signing contracts or transferring money to any consultant claiming to offer overseas education services.

]

Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 1998 durch Holger Hoffmann und René La Fontaine haben wir uns zu einem weltweit führenden Unternehmen entwickelt, das in über 30 Ländern vertreten ist und mehrfach ausgezeichnet wurde. Doch Goldeneye ist weit mehr als nur ein Unternehmen – es ist eine Familie, bestehend aus internationalen Stars, Botschaftern und Trainern.

,

Unsere eigens entwickelte Methode hat sich zu einer umfassenden Wissenssammlung aller Kreativtechniken entwickelt, die wir nun in unserem Kunden-Netzwerk teilen möchten. Ob über digitale Wissensplattformen, erstklassigen Präsenzunterricht, Basiskurse oder Masterklassen von internationalen Größen – wir bieten ein umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und eine große Auswahl zertifizierter Produkte, die sich jeder individuellen Arbeitsweise anpassen lassen.

,

Mit besten, langanhaltenden und sicheren Ergebnissen, hergestellt in Deutschland, setzen wir Maßstäbe in der Branche. Tauchen Sie ein in die Welt von Goldeneye und entdecken Sie, wie wir Ihre Permanent Make-Up Erfahrung revolutionieren können.

,

Die Coloressense Pigmente überzeugen durch Farbbrillanz, Langhaltbarkeit und optimale Hautverträglichkeit.

,

Die Goldeneye Geräte stehen für modernste Technik, Komfort und perfekte Ergebnisse in der professionellen Pigmentierung.

,

Nutzen Sie Needling, um Ihr Angebot zu erweitern und mit modernen Methoden zu überzeugen.

,

Die Goldeneye Pflegeserie ist eine Zusammenstellung von hochwertigen Produkten, die der Haut nur das Beste bieten.

Unsere Basis-Ausbildung "Master of Powder" bietet Ihnen eine umfassende Einführung in die Welt des Goldeneye Pigmentisten.

short_bio:
[

About Us

,

REACTION Nepal is a government-registered interdisciplinary organization with its headquarters in Putalisadak, Kathmandu, Nepal. With its establishment in 2005, it mainly aims at providing education services to all seeking their study and career prospects in and out of the country.

,

REACTION Nepal was established by the noble efforts and endeavors of a group of dedicated and qualified professionals with diverse academic expertise in the fields of applied education, science, and technology, with the sole objective of providing the student community with the most appropriate training and educational opportunities aboard. REACTION Nepal, with its team of experienced professionals and academics, provides counseling services for those students who wish to pursue their further studies abroad in well-reputed colleges, institutions, and universities in different countries on all continents, such as Asia-Pacific, Australia, Europe, and North America.

,

I was a bit confused about the choice of a proper academic institution for my study abroad options. On my friend’s recommendation, I came in touch with the counsellor at RNC. His advice was genuine, and I followed it consistently until I finally reached Sydney (my dream destination). I am very happy with the RNC team, and I feel lucky for my enrollment at RNC.

,

While I was looking for a good study abroad counseling institution for my test preparation and processing purposes, I luckily found Reaction Nepal Consultants Pvt.  Ltd. I got a lot of ideas and feedbacks about not only the test preparation but also in the selection of college which would suit to my career needs. I am quite grateful to Reaction Nepal consultants for all these guidance and support. It is the academic counselors at Reaction Nepal who recommended me to the case of ATMC in Australia and finally it became my study destination.

,

In the beginning when I joined Reaction Nepal Consultants, I was quite skeptical about their quality in terms of test preparation on IELTS. I had already tried a couple of institutions for my IELTS preparation. But, as I started my classes at RNC, I started many significant changes. It really boosted my confidence and within just 2 months, I was able to score 7.0 which enabled to admit myself at such a reputed university Australia Catholic University in Australia for Nursing. No words to thanks RNC!

,

From having almost no interest and experience to reaching to a point of being able to gain highly recognized US education,Reaction was all along with me guiding me like their child.Starting from Ielts class,good guidance about colleges and future discussion they take each and every aspect very detailed and seriously.Reaction works as a team together with you to help u take that baby steps and reach to the place you have dreamt of.At least they did it for me. I am forever grateful towards Reaction team. They were an absolute gem.

,

Studying at RNC was a dream come true! With their expert guidance, I secured my student visa in no time. The supportive staff and seamless process made everything stress-free. Thanks to RNC, I’m now pursuing my education abroad with confidence. Highly recommend!

,

I'm thrilled to have received my Australian student visa for Ozford Institute of Higher Education, all thanks to RNC Consultancy! Their team guided me perfectly—from course selection to GTE statement and visa documentation. They made the complex process stress-free with their expertise and prompt responses. My visa was approved in just 3 weeks! Highly recommend RNC to any Nepali student dreaming of studying in Australia. Trust me, they deliver results!

,

I couldn’t believe how smooth my Australia visa process was with RNC Consultancy! Their team handled everything—from document preparation to interview coaching—with absolute professionalism. Thanks to their guidance, my visa was approved faster than I expected. For any Nepali student dreaming of studying in Australia, RNC is the consultancy you can trust. They don’t just promise results; they deliver them!

,

My Australian student visa journey with RNC Consultancy was nothing short of amazing! Their step-by-step guidance transformed my nervousness into confidence. From perfecting my documents to nailing the visa interview, their experts were with me at every stage. The best part? No unnecessary delays or surprises - just a straightforward path to approval. If you want a stress-free visa experience with zero guesswork, RNC is your best choice!

,

Choosing RNC Consultancy was the best decision for my Australian visa process! Their team explained every requirement clearly and double-checked all my documents before submission. When I got my approval email, I actually cried happy tears! Their attention to detail and personalized support made all the difference. For any Nepali student applying to Australia - don't take chances, go with the experts at RNC!

,

name: Speed International Pvt. Ltd.
short_bio:
[

Speed International, is one of the pioneers in the field of abroad education counselling in Nepal since 2004. We are recognized and registered center as per Nepal Government policy. We were specialized in counselling of medical education in China, Bangladesh, Philippines, Kyrgyzstan etc. with over 19 years of experience. Similarly, we are guiding prospective students to find the right institutes for International Degree in destinations like Australia, USA, United Kingdom, Canada, New Zealand and many more.

,

We recruit teachers in different universities as per universities need to make students education more efficiency. Same way our every university in China has recruited coordinators from South Asia to make students comfortable while studying. These coordinators will looks after student's daily life and works as a bridge between student and university officials.

,

The education of International students in New China began in 1950, and has witnessed great development in recent years. Statistics show that 363 universities in 31 Chinese provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities (not including Taiwan Province, Hong Kong and Macao special administrative regions) received large number students from l69 countries to study in China.

,

Dali University is also of the 90 Universities in China that the Chinese Ministry of Education recommends for International Students.

,

I am currently practicing as Resident Physician in the USA. It was great to join Dali University for my MBBS study. Before joining the university we heard negative feedback about study in China. But it was beyond what we heard. The University had a balance curriculum and clinical exposures that can be feasible for all international students. Similarly, we cannot imagine the infrastructure and facilities that Dali had in the medical institutions of Nepal.

,

My self Dr. Nur Hoda Dewan enrolled at Dali University in 2011 batch and graduate in 2017. I passed NMC licensing exam in first attempt in and was practicing in Birgunj my home town for 2 years. I again joined Dali University for Post Graduate in Internal Medicine. I had good experience with Dali University and feel one of the best University for medical education. I am glad and thankful to my teachers of Dali University and the support given by speed International.

,

Being a parent it is always fear, confusion and hesitation to send daughter for abroad study. Main concern is about her safety, living environment and definitely standard of education. I can clearly see the experience of 17 years of Speed members as supportive and guidance students. Choosing Dali University was right decision where my daughter is enjoying her study with good performance.

]

short_bio:
[

The Ministry of Education, Science and Technology (MoEST) has officially published the complete list of educational consultancy institutions that have successfully completed their renewal process for fiscal year 2082/83.

,

The ministry has urged students and parents to carefully verify the specific services any given consultancy is authorised to provide before enrolling or paying fees. Approved services range widely across the sector:

,

Consultancy firms are simultaneously reminded that they may only operate within the scope of services for which they hold explicit approval. Operating outside approved service categories is a direct violation of MoEST regulations and may result in cancellation of registration.

,

The complete directory of renewed consultancies for FY 2082/83, along with the formal gazette notice and service-category breakdowns for each firm, is available on the official MoEST website. The issuing authority is the Educational Consultancy Certification Branch, Singha Durbar, Kathmandu.

,

Nepal sends tens of thousands of students abroad each year — primarily to Australia, Japan, Canada, the United States, and various European nations. The education consultancy sector has at times been marked by misinformation, unregistered operators, and excessive fee charging, making this official transparency measure especially significant for families navigating the process.

,

By publishing a verified roster of cleared firms, MoEST gives students a reliable reference point to cross-check before signing contracts or transferring money to any consultant claiming to offer overseas education services.

]

name: GLOSSA PREPARATORY ACADEMY PVT. LTD
short_bio:
[

Table of Contents

,

 

Located at Putalisadak, Kathmandu, glossaPREP was established as a fundamental preparatory institute to meet the need of students looking forward on gaining higher level of education. glossaPREP provides classes for candidates looking to give standardized tests such as GMAT, SAT, GRE, IELTS and TOEFL which are used by foreign universities as a criteria. Level of IELTS and TOEFL are also used by some countries as a criterion while applying for job VISA or Permanent Resident (PR).  glossaPREP also conducts preparation classes for entrance tests which are conducted by Nepalese Universities and Colleges such as KUMAT, SOMAT, CMAT, GMAT and KUUMAT.  glossaPREP specializes on conducting test preparation  classes, but also provide students with authentic counseling upon requirement.

By the guidance of the faculty members of glossaPREP, some of the candidates of standardized test have already set up unrivalled records globally. The faculty members work hard for creating similar results for other Nepalese students who look forward on getting good unparalleled grade in various testing events in Nepal. For providing students the necessary tools, knowledge and information, glossaPREP has developed a full-fledged academic department. The department is leaded by the Director of Studies. The department is further classified into three segments consisting of academic team of faculty heads, professors and administrative staffs. The classrooms are fully furnished according to international standard and are equipped with projectors for some of the specific programs. Providing a good study environment, glossaPREP also has big library with plenty of books and resource materials for aiding students. The slogan of glossaPREP is “You Just Aspire, We Prepare!”

name: Chitwan Chiba Education Center
short_bio:
[

Your ultimate gateway to mastering the Japanese language in Kathmandu and seamlessly preparing for higher education opportunities in Japan, all while staying rooted in Nepal.

,

Chiba Education Center (CEC) is a trusted consultancy dedicated to helping students achieve their dreams of studying in Japan. With a focus on personalized guidance, the center offers comprehensive services including counselling to help students choose the right course and institution, documentation assistance to ensure all paperwork is accurate and complete, and visa processing to streamline the application process.

,

In addition to academic and visa services, Chiba Education Center also offers Japanese language classes to help students build essential communication skills and adapt to life in Japan. CEC also assist with travel arrangements, ensuring a smooth transition from Nepal to Japan. Whether it's academic planning, language preparation, or logistical support, Chiba Education Center is committed to empowering students and confidence they need to succeed in their educational journey.

,

Japanese is written in a mixture of Hiragana, Katakana and Kanji. The Japanese initially adopted Chinese writing script for its written language. However, over time, Chinese character (Kanji) were supplemented by two other types of scripts were developed. Hiragana and Katakana are both syllabicated, where each character is representative of a syllable. The education training process with as an aspect of social interaction with the view of the institution as a social group.

,

"Chiba Education Center made my dream of studying in Japan come true! Their counselling and visa support were flawless, and the team guided me every step of the way. Highly recommended!"

,

"Thanks to Chiba Education Center, studying in Japan felt effortless! Their language classes prepared me well, and their travel arrangements were perfect. I couldn’t have done it without their support!"

,

"Chiba Education Center is amazing! They helped me with everything—from choosing the right college to visa processing. Their team is professional, friendly, and always ready to help. Highly recommend them!"

,

"I was nervous about studying abroad, but Chiba Education Center made everything so easy. Their documentation and counselling services were top-notch, and their guidance gave me confidence. Thank you, Chiba!"

,

"Chiba Education Center is the best! Their language classes were incredibly helpful, and their visa processing was quick and hassle-free. I’m now living my dream in Japan, all thanks to their support!"

name: Nepal Japan Counselling Centre Pvt. Ltd.
short_bio:
[

Pursue your higher education dreams in Japan with our expert guidance and support.

,

NJCC serves as a focused bridge between Nepal and Japan, helping students navigate the academic and procedural requirements involved in studying abroad. Our role goes beyond application handling — we guide students in making informed academic decisions, understanding institutional expectations, and preparing responsibly for international study. Every step of the process is approached with clarity and structured planning, ensuring students understand both opportunities and responsibilities before moving forward. By maintaining a disciplined and student-centered approach, NJCC supports individuals who are serious about building a stable and academically meaningful future in Japan.

,

Nepal Japan Counselling Centre Pvt. Ltd (NJCC) is a well-known educational consultancy founded in 2012 A.D., located in Sorhakhutte, Kathmandu. We are officially recognized by the Nepalese government and are proud members of ECAN (Educational Consultancy Association of Nepal).

,

Our mission is to provide the best counseling to Nepali students who want to pursue their higher education goals in Japan. We bridge the gap between students' aspirations and Japanese educational opportunities through professional guidance and comprehensive support services.

,

Hear from our successful students about their experiences in Japan.

,

Japan offers quality education at reasonable tuition fees with manageable living expenses.

,

Our team has extensive experience in Japanese education system and visa processes.

name: Aki Educational Consultancy Pvt. Ltd.
short_bio:
[

The Ministry of Education, Science and Technology (MoEST) has officially published the complete list of educational consultancy institutions that have successfully completed their renewal process for fiscal year 2082/83.

,

The ministry has urged students and parents to carefully verify the specific services any given consultancy is authorised to provide before enrolling or paying fees. Approved services range widely across the sector:

,

Consultancy firms are simultaneously reminded that they may only operate within the scope of services for which they hold explicit approval. Operating outside approved service categories is a direct violation of MoEST regulations and may result in cancellation of registration.

,

The complete directory of renewed consultancies for FY 2082/83, along with the formal gazette notice and service-category breakdowns for each firm, is available on the official MoEST website. The issuing authority is the Educational Consultancy Certification Branch, Singha Durbar, Kathmandu.

,

Nepal sends tens of thousands of students abroad each year — primarily to Australia, Japan, Canada, the United States, and various European nations. The education consultancy sector has at times been marked by misinformation, unregistered operators, and excessive fee charging, making this official transparency measure especially significant for families navigating the process.

,

By publishing a verified roster of cleared firms, MoEST gives students a reliable reference point to cross-check before signing contracts or transferring money to any consultant claiming to offer overseas education services.

]

name: New Nobel institute Pvt. Ltd
short_bio:
[

For assistance with the scrutiny necessary for the prize adjudication and for promoting the objectives of the Foundation in other ways, the prize-awarding bodies may establish Nobel Institutes.

,

Statutes of the Nobel Foundation, § 12

,

The Norwegian Nobel Institute was established 1 February, 1904, tasked with supporting the Nobel Committee in its review of nominations and candidates for the Nobel Peace Prize. According to § 12 of the Nobel Foundation statutes, "each Nobel Institute shall be under the leadership of the prize-awarding body that established it." The Director of the Institute is the Nobel Committee's permanent secretary, and the Institute can be regarded as the Committee's secretariat. The events in December are all planned and coordinated through this office.

,

The first few years the Institute rented offices in Victoria Terrasse in downtown Oslo, but by May 1905 the move was made to the present building in Henrik Ibsens gate 51. The award ceremony was moved there the same year, having previously taken place in the Storting (Norwegian Parliament). The building, originally constructed in 1867 as a private residence, had by then undergone extensive renovation.

,

The Institute contains offices, a meeting room, the Grand Hall, a research department, library and reading room. The Nobel Committee meets in a special meeting room devoted exclusively to this purpose. The tradition has gradually developed of using the Institute’s Grand Hall both for the announcement of the year's Peace Prize in October and for the Laureate's press conference on 9 December, the day before the award ceremony in Oslo City Hall.

,

The Nobel Institute arranges meetings, lectures and seminars, as well as so-called Nobel Symposia. The symposia are attended by specially invited academic scholars, experts and decision-makers from many countries who gather to discuss selected topics relating to peace and conflicts.

,

short_bio:
[

Our consultancy, headquartered in Ramshah Path, Putalisadak, Kathmandu, aligns with this philosophy by offering training programs for aspirational Airplane and Helicopter Pilots via our partner institutions. We have an impressive record, having successfully guided over 60 students into becoming pilots employed by various airlines across Nepal.

,

Our consultancy, situated in Ramshah Path, Putalisadak, Kathmandu, takes pride in fostering the dreams of those eager to soar the skies. Our strength lies in our partnerships with top-flight training institutions in South Africa, the USA, and the Philippines. Some EASA-certified institutions have garnered over two decades of experience training Nepalese students, utilizing modern aircraft and facilities. We offer training programs for aspiring Airplane and Helicopter Pilots and have already successfully guided over 60 students to become pilots, now serving various airline companies across Nepal.

,

In addition to providing high-quality education, the Philippines offers foreign students ample recreation opportunities. Beyond their rigorous academic commitments, students can enjoy many outdoor activities in pristine beach settings, heritage sites showcasing Asian and European architecture, and other tourist spots. Students can enjoy luxurious amenities at five-star hotels, restaurants, entertainment venues, shopping malls, and cafes.

,

Furthermore, studying in the Philippines is comparatively more affordable than other countries offering high-quality education. A moderate lifestyle can be maintained on a monthly budget of US$350 to US$500.

,

Understand a wide range of demanding, longer texts and recognize implicit meaning. Can express him/herself fluently and spontaneously without much apparent searching for expressions. Use language flexibly and effectively for social, academic, and professional purposes. Can produce clear, well-structured, detailed text on complex subjects, showing controlled use of organizational patterns, connectors, and cohesive devices. 

,

Can understand the main ideas of complex text on both concrete and abstract topics, including technical discussions in his/her field of specialization. Can interact with a degree of oral fluency and spontaneity that makes regular interaction with native speakers quite possible without strain for either party. Can produce clear, detailed text on a wide range of subjects and explain a viewpoint on a topical issue giving the advantages and disadvantages of various options. 

,

Can understand and use familiar everyday expressions and fundamental phrases aimed at the satisfaction of needs of a concrete type. Can introduce himself/herself and others and ask and answer questions about personal details such as where he/she lives, people he/she knows, and things he/she has. Can interact, provided the other person talks slowly and clearly and is prepared to help.  

,

Established in 2009, Kathmandu Alliance Education (KAE) Pvt. Ltd is a dedicated educational consultancy company with more than 13 years of experience in the field. Our mission is to deliver accurate, unbiased information to Nepalese students aspiring to pursue higher education abroad.

,

 KAE's operations extend to major educational destinations, including the UK, Scotland, USA, Philippines, South Africa, and Canada Immigration. We consistently explore partnerships with esteemed colleges and universities worldwide to expand our reach.

,

 Our headquarters are strategically situated in Kathmandu, Nepal's capital and the heart of its economic and educational activities. Kathmandu's diverse landscape, cultural uniqueness, and vast business potential make it an ideal location for KAE and its partners to thrive.

,

 Leveraging the growing interest of Nepalese students in studying abroad, and our partners' desire to expand into the Nepalese market, KAE has become a crucial link connecting students with their educational goals abroad.

,

 While consultancy remains our core focus, we also offer preparation classes for PTE, IELTS, flight training ground classes, visa document processing, and career counselling. Plans are underway to extend our reach by setting up branches in other significant cities within Nepal and targeting major cities worldwide as potential future locations.

,

KAE is an experienced educational consultancy firm with a global reach, specializing in fields like pilot training and various academic disciplines.

,

,

KAE's extensive network of partner universities across different countries sets them apart from other consultancies. Their connections opened doors to numerous educational opportunities that I wouldn't have discovered otherwise. With KAE, the world truly becomes your classroom.

,

,

KAE's expansion plans are a testament to their dedication to making education accessible to all. With new branches and global partnerships, KAE is paving the way for a brighter future for Nepalese students seeking education abroad.

short_bio:

The Ministry of Education, Science and Technology (MoEST) has officially published the complete list of educational consultancy institutions that have successfully completed their renewal process for fiscal year 2082/83.

,

The ministry has urged students and parents to carefully verify the specific services any given consultancy is authorised to provide before enrolling or paying fees. Approved services range widely across the sector:

,

Consultancy firms are simultaneously reminded that they may only operate within the scope of services for which they hold explicit approval. Operating outside approved service categories is a direct violation of MoEST regulations and may result in cancellation of registration.

,

The complete directory of renewed consultancies for FY 2082/83, along with the formal gazette notice and service-category breakdowns for each firm, is available on the official MoEST website. The issuing authority is the Educational Consultancy Certification Branch, Singha Durbar, Kathmandu.

,

Nepal sends tens of thousands of students abroad each year — primarily to Australia, Japan, Canada, the United States, and various European nations. The education consultancy sector has at times been marked by misinformation, unregistered operators, and excessive fee charging, making this official transparency measure especially significant for families navigating the process.

,

By publishing a verified roster of cleared firms, MoEST gives students a reliable reference point to cross-check before signing contracts or transferring money to any consultant claiming to offer overseas education services.

]

name: International School of Travel and Learning
short_bio:
[

ITSS-TSaT and TeraIBS Summer School 2026

,

ITSS-TSaT and TeraIBS Summer School 2026

,

International Traveling Summer School on Terahertz Sciences and Technology

,

hosted by University of Duisburg-Essen
Duisburg, Germany

,

Step into the world of Terahertz technology — an emerging field at the heart of tomorrow’s solutions for climate change monitoring, food security, precision agriculture, counterfeit medicine detection, 6G wireless communications, and the remote sensing of explosives and hazardous materials.

,

Learn from and interact with over 25 world-leading experts from academia and industry as they share insights into the latest advances in THz science, technology, and applications. You will also collaborate in small groups on a Terahertz-related challenge project.

,

Bachelor’s, Master’s, and Ph.D. students, Postdocs, teachers, industry researchers, and end users are all warmly invited to take part in this unique opportunity!

,

,

The International Traveling Summer School on Terahertz Sciences and Technology (formerly known as the Terahertz Technologies & Applications Summer School – TTASS) has been organized by participating universities and institutes since 1990, taking place in a different location each year.

,

In 2020, the summer school was scheduled to be held at Eindhoven University of Technology (TU/e) in the Netherlands, organized by the Research Group Terahertz Photonic Systems at TU/e. However, due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the event was postponed. In 2021, the 30th anniversary edition took place online, and the event changed its name, as traveling was not possible. In 2022, the school returned to its traditional format and was hosted in Warsaw (Poland), followed by Eindhoven (Netherlands) in 2023, Vilnius (Lithuania) in 2024, and Vienna (Austria) in 2025.

,

In 2026, the Summer School is coming to Duisburg, Germany! From July 12th to 17th, the University of Duisburg-Essen will host ITSS-TSaT, jointly organized with TU/e TeraIBs academy.

,

The language of the Summer School is English. The program includes lectures presenting the latest achievements in Terahertz technologies and applications, followed by discussions and lively interactions among students, professors, and industry professionals. Participants will take part in group challenges, visit the THz laboratories and chip technology facilities at UDE, and enjoy a variety of social events.

,

We are looking forward to welcoming you this summer! Join us for a week of exploration, learning, and inspiring connections.

,

The ITSS-TSaT / TeraIBs Summer School Team

,

The Fraunhofer inHaus center is a central location in UDE’s campus area in Duisburg, where many scientific and engineering conferences and workshops are taking place.

,

All lectures and poster sessions are located at inHouse between Monday and Friday (Forsthausweg 1, 47057 Duisburg, Germany).

,

The welcoming reception on Sunday July 12th will be held nearby, on the greens in front of ZHO, UDE’s Center for Semiconductor Technology and Optoelectronics (Lotharstrasse 55, 47057 Duisburg).

,

,

contact ITSS-TSaT by email: bhe-sekretariat@uni-due.de or through the contact form. We will get back to you as soon as possible.

Step into the world of Terahertz technology — an emerging field at the heart of tomorrow’s solutions for climate change monitoring, food security, precision agriculture, counterfeit medicine detection, 6G wireless communications, and the remote sensing of explosives and hazardous materials.

,

Learn from and interact with over 25 world-leading experts from academia and industry as they share insights into the latest advances in THz science, technology, and applications. You will also collaborate in small groups on a Terahertz-related challenge project.

,

Bachelor’s, Master’s, and Ph.D. students, Postdocs, teachers, industry researchers, and end users are all warmly invited to take part in this unique opportunity!

,

,

The International Traveling Summer School on Terahertz Sciences and Technology (formerly known as the Terahertz Technologies & Applications Summer School – TTASS) has been organized by participating universities and institutes since 1990, taking place in a different location each year.

,

In 2020, the summer school was scheduled to be held at Eindhoven University of Technology (TU/e) in the Netherlands, organized by the Research Group Terahertz Photonic Systems at TU/e. However, due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the event was postponed. In 2021, the 30th anniversary edition took place online, and the event changed its name, as traveling was not possible. In 2022, the school returned to its traditional format and was hosted in Warsaw (Poland), followed by Eindhoven (Netherlands) in 2023, Vilnius (Lithuania) in 2024, and Vienna (Austria) in 2025.

,

In 2026, the Summer School is coming to Duisburg, Germany! From July 12th to 17th, the University of Duisburg-Essen will host ITSS-TSaT, jointly organized with TU/e TeraIBs academy.

,

The language of the Summer School is English. The program includes lectures presenting the latest achievements in Terahertz technologies and applications, followed by discussions and lively interactions among students, professors, and industry professionals. Participants will take part in group challenges, visit the THz laboratories and chip technology facilities at UDE, and enjoy a variety of social events.

,

We are looking forward to welcoming you this summer! Join us for a week of exploration, learning, and inspiring connections.

,

The ITSS-TSaT / TeraIBs Summer School Team

,

The Fraunhofer inHaus center is a central location in UDE’s campus area in Duisburg, where many scientific and engineering conferences and workshops are taking place.

,

All lectures and poster sessions are located at inHouse between Monday and Friday (Forsthausweg 1, 47057 Duisburg, Germany).

,

The welcoming reception on Sunday July 12th will be held nearby, on the greens in front of ZHO, UDE’s Center for Semiconductor Technology and Optoelectronics (Lotharstrasse 55, 47057 Duisburg).

,

contact ITSS-TSaT by email: bhe-sekretariat@uni-due.de or through the contact form. We will get back to you as soon as possible.

short_bio:
[



รับทำเอกสารและแนะแนว

ไปเรียนต่อที่ญี่ปุ่น

เรียนในโรงเรียนสอนภาษาญี่ปุ่นที่มีให้เลือกกว่า 80 แห่งทั่วญี่ปุ่น เปิดตลอดทั้งปี ทั้งระยะสั้นและยาว

ฟรี

  • แปลเอกสาร
  • ปรึกษาเอกสาร
  • บริการหาที่พัก
  • ดูแลจนถึงเรียนจบ
สมัครเลย รายละเอียด

สอนภาษาญี่ปุ่นตั้งแต่ระดับต้น-สูง

เรียนภาษาญี่ปุ่น

คลาสเรียนยืดหยุ่น มีทั้งแบบเรียนเดี่ยว เรียนกลุ่ม และเลือกเวลาเรียนได้

  • เรียนที่อิจิบัง
  • เรียนแบบออนไลน์
  • เรียนแบบเร่งรัดเพื่อไปเรียนต่อที่ญี่ปุ่น
  • หลักสูตรติว JLPT
สมัครเลย รายละเอียด
บริการครบวงจร

ไปญี่ปุ่นด้วยวีซ่านักเรียน เพื่อการศึกษาต่อระดับมหาวิทยาลัยและการทำงานต่อ ด้วยประสบการณ์กว่า 10 ปี เป็นตัวแทนแนะนำการศึกษาต่อแห่งแรกในภาคเหนือ

ดูข่าวสารผ่านเพจ ที่นี่
ไม่มีพื้นฐานก็ไปเรียนได้

เพราะมีบริการสอนภาษาญี่ปุ่น ทั้งที่สถาบัน และทางออนไลน์ สามารถเรียนเพื่อเตรียมตัวไปเรียนต่อที่ญี่ปุ่น

ดูรายละเอียดคอร์ส
สมัครกับอิจิบัง
  • จ่ายน้อยกว่าสมัครเอง เพราะไม่มีค่าแปลเอกสาร และค่าดำเนินเอกสารใดๆทั้งสิ้น
  • ดำเนินเอกสารผ่านทางออนไลน์ได้ ไม่จำเป็นต้องเดินทางมาที่สำนักงาน ให้บริการได้ทั่วไทย
  • รับปรึกษาทุกเคส แนะนำโรงเรียนได้หลากหลาย ตามจุดประสงค์ ไม่ว่าจะเป็น โรงเรียนหลักสูตรทำงาน หลักสูตรเรียนต่อ โรงเรียนค่าเทอมถูก โรงเรียนมีทุนสนับสนุน
  • ดูแลตั้งแต่การสมัคร จนถึงการใช้ชีวิตในญี่ปุ่น มีไกด์ไลน์ทุกขั้นตอน
ดูโรงเรียนที่แนะนำที่นี่
ติดตามอิจิบังได้ทุกช่องทาง

รีวิวบรรยากาศคอร์สเรียน

มีคอร์สเรียนหลากหลาย

อิจิบัง มีคอร์สให้เลือกทุกรูปแบบที่ต้องการ ทั้งคอร์สเรียนเดี่ยว คอร์สเรียนกลุ่ม คอร์สเร่งรัด และมีผู้เรียนจริง สามารถออกใบรับรองชั่วโมงการเรียนได้
สมัครคอร์สเรียนเลย

ดำเนินการเอกสารไปเรียนต่อที่ญี่ปุ่น

ดำเนินการทุกขั้นตอน ตั้งแต่เอกสารการสมัคร จนถึงตอนที่เดินทางไปญี่ปุ่น และปรึกษาหลังเรียนจบที่ญี่ปุ่น
ดูรายละเอียดที่นี่

ติดตามฟอโร่วทางช่องทางต่างๆได้ที่นี่

name: Samurai Japanese Language School Consultancy PvtLtd..
short_bio:
[

We have Agreements with Japanese Language Schools in Japan.

,

Japanese language schools offer different type of programs to the students such as, Standard Japanese course; Conversation focused course, Preparation for Higher Education and Language plus Cultural Activity course.
With Japan Language School, students will learn the Japanese language and culture rapidly within months comparing to studying in their own country. Course length varies from few weeks (short term) to maximum of 2 years (long term). This is often called preparatory courses especially for students aiming to enter higher education.

,

• Required documents to face to the interview which held by Japanese Language School in Japan.

,


1. passed N5 certificate
2. G.C.E A/L and O/L result sheet [must be certified by Foreign Ministry.]
3. Original School Leaving certificate
4. Original Birth Certificate[must be received from city office in 3 months]
5. National Identity card [photo copy]
6. English translations of above 3,4,5
7. Colored photo copy of Passport
8. Other educational certificate [degree, diploma etc.]
9. Service Letter [If you worked or working]
10. Ten color photos 3cm 4cm [must be taken in one month]
11. National Identity card of sponsor
12. Birth Certificate of sponsor
13. Bank balance conformation letter
14. Bank transactions [3 years]
15. Business registration or service letter
16. six month Salary sheet or Income Report

,

We review all documents above and send the scanned documents to the Japanese Language School in Japan by email. Then they review the documents and arrange an interview with applicant.

The interview will be face to face or through Skype. After passing the interview, we translate all the documents to Japanese and correct when necessary. Once cleared you might need to send the originals and application fee to the school, though it varies school to school.

After your application is sent to the Japanese school in japan, they will submit your documents to the Regional Immigration Bureau in Japan. The final decision is taken by the Regional Immigration Bureau in Japan about your certificate of Eligibility and it will take about 3 months.

,

If you will be lucky enough ,you will receive the Certificate of Eligibility from Immigration Bureau (Permission from the Japanese Government to be granted a Student visa). The Japanese school will receive your Certificate of Eligibility and they will send us it’s scanned copy, school admission and invoice by e-mail.

Then we will give you their print outs and you remit the invoiced fees to the school by a TT transfer. After confirmation of payment, Japanese school in japan will send us the original Certificate of Eligibility and Admission Certificate by DHL.

After we receive the DHL we will give it to you and you should submit COE with all other supporting documents at the Japanese Embassy in Sri Lanka to apply for your visa. We will arrange an appointment for that and Japanese Embassy in Sri Lanka will get 7 days to stamp visa to your passport. Now you have your student visa, you are now ready to fly to Japan.

,

]

short_bio:
[

At Unireach, we earnestly believe in celebrating students and their potential. Our aim is to bridge the gap between aspiring students and the universities they rightly deserve by helping them channelize their strengths and overcome their weaknesses. We inevitably stand out for meticulously crafting individual stories and empowering students to find their authentic voice throughout the daunting process of college applications. As seasoned counselors with an experience of more than 10 years in the industry, we understand the pulse of the overseas admissions process and guide students in making informed decisions about their future. From continual counseling at each step to providing students with real-time feedback, our system of profile development is highly personalized as we are constantly evolving the best practices and strategies to help students navigate the college landscape.

,

Unireach was born out of this inordinate desire to rectify the misinformation and bust these misconceptions about overseas admissions prevailing in the market. The founders launched Unireach with a selective number of students and began to expand as the students were successfully able to traverse their journey to excellence. They would give students the freedom to tap into their interests authentically and devise for them strategic and individualized career paths. These tireless and diligent efforts have led to the establishment of an unblemished, immersive, and transparent system that perpetually reinforces the belief of students and parents in Unireach and its top-notch services.

,

Aakriti switched from her profession as an Indirect Tax Lawyer with Ernst and Young to Education in 2014 when she joined the Jayshree Periwal International School. Spearheading youth initiatives and college counselling in the school, Aakriti successfully counsels JPIS students to top universities across the globe including Stanford, Yale, Harvard, Cornell. Brown, Dartmouth, University of Oxford and more.

,

Aakriti’s dedication has been recognized with prestigious awards, including the ‘Outstanding Educator’ by the University of Chicago and the ‘No.1 Career Counseling in India’ by Education World. With Unireach, Aakriti continues to empower students to achieve their academic dreams and build bright futures.

,

At Unireach Consulting, he has simplified the convoluted scenario of overseas admissions in India. Counseling them at every step as they steer towards their dream college, he has made the university experience more accessible for aspirants. He has recently been honoured with the prestigious ‘Human Development Leader Award (2023-24)’ by Education World. 

,

It wasn’t until she ran the rat race herself, that she realized her true passion lay in helping others run, through education and mentorship, and finding the right race for them- be it a triathlon, a plogathon, a sprint, or simply a jog in the park!

,

Apart from his professional responsibilities, he is also an author with four books to his credit and a student of English literature from Kirorimal College, University of Delhi. His academic journey has not only honed his communication and critical thinking skills but also instilled in him an ardent love for language and education. He is also a committed English educator and public speaking trainer. 

,

With over a decade of experience in the field of education consulting and test prep, Sheetal brings to the table her expertise in guiding students through international admissions. A graduate of Narsee Monjee College of Commerce & Economics, and a certified IELTS Trainer through the British Council, she also holds a Global Counselor Certification from the University of California, Los Angeles.

,

Before moving into education counselling, Mansi spent over a decade working in the United States and Singapore in Data Science, Business analytics, and the Technology industry. She led Analytics and Dashboarding projects at GroupM for major global clients, and managed transformation programmes at Citibank. This professional background gives her a grounded, real-world view of how careers develop across industries and geographies.

,

She later transitioned into education counseling and has been working with students from grades 8 to 10, guiding them on building strong profiles for admission to universities abroad. Her focus is on helping students think ahead: understanding what top universities are looking for beyond grades and test scores. A strong academic record matters, but it is rarely enough on its own. Admissions committees at selective universities want to see a student who is well-rounded, purposeful, and has pursued interests with genuine depth.

,

I wouldn’t even imagine getting nearly this far without Aakriti ma’am and Ayush sir. From being the first one in school at 5 am to missing their Diwali and winter break to go over our applications, they’ve always led by example and inspired me to do my best. They didn’t just give me detailed feedback on my essays but also made me laugh when I was at my lowest and made sure that I was in a comfortable environment. They haven’t only counselled me for college but are my mentors for life. Somehow they managed to make the stressful college app season one of the most fun and memorable times of my high school journey. They’ve taught me how to dream big while being the guiding light for those dreams. Thank you Aakriti ma’am and Ayush sir for helping me grow as a person, I am eternally grateful for y’all.

Submit Documents for Certificate of Eligibility (CoE)Once accepted, your institution will apply for a Certificate of Eligibility (CoE) on your behalf. Choose the Right Course and InstitutionYour study journey begins with selecting the right course and university that align with your interests and career goals. It’s not just about getting a visa—it’s about picking a course that suits you best.Take time to research the many programs offered by Australian institutions. Immigration officials expect your academic choices to be logical and genuine.2. Check Your EligibilityBefore proceeding with your visa application, ensure you meet all eligibility requirements set by the Australian government. This crucial step can determine whether your application is successful.You need to:Have an Offer of EnrollmentYou must receive an official offer letter from an Australian institution recognized by the government. After accepting the offer and paying the deposit, you will get a Confirmation of Enrolment (CoE), proving your registration in a CRICOS-registered course.Demonstrate Financial CapacityYou must prove you have enough funds to cover tuition fees, living expenses (approximately AUD 29,710 per year in 2025), health insurance, and travel costs. Acceptable proof includes bank statements, loan approvals, scholarship letters, or a sponsor’s financial guarantee.Purchase Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC)Health insurance is mandatory for all international students in Australia. You can buy OSHC from your university or approved providers like Bupa, Allianz, or Medibank. Your OSHC must cover your entire study duration.Meeting these basic criteria will ensure a smoother application process. Once confirmed, you’re ready for the next step.3. Gather Required DocumentsAfter confirming your eligibility, collect all necessary documents to support your visa application. These documents help the Department of Home Affairs assess your case.Typical documents include:Valid passportConfirmation of Enrolment (CoE)Statement of Purpose (SOP)Proof of financial capacityOverseas Student Health Cover (OSHC)English language proficiency test resultsAcademic transcripts and work experience certificates (if applicable)4. Pay the Visa Application FeeOnce your application is submitted, you will be required to pay the visa application fee. The fee amount depends on the specific visa subclass and may vary, so check the current rates before applying.5. Visa Processing and DecisionYour application will be reviewed by the Department of Home Affairs. Processing times can vary, so apply as early as possible to avoid delays. Use the Transaction Reference Number (TRN) provided after submission to track your application status online.Possible outcomes:Visa ApprovedCongratulations! Your student visa has been granted. Each case is reviewed individually, and there may be multiple reasons behind a refusal.6. Preparing for Travel After Visa ApprovalOnce your visa is granted, you will receive a visa grant notice detailing the visa conditions. Understanding each step—from course selection to departure—will help you stay organized and confident.Once your visa is approved, focus on preparing for your new life in Australia. With its excellent education system and welcoming multicultural environment, your study experience will be rewarding and life-changing. Stay organized, follow your visa conditions, and get ready for an exciting academic journey!

The quality of the lead manager often influences investor confidence in the IPO. Reputed merchant bankers like SBI Capital, Axis Capital, IIFL, and others have a track record of managing successful listings. However, it is always advisable to evaluate the issuer company's fundamentals independently before applying to any IPO.

,

A lead manager (merchant banker) is a SEBI-registered entity responsible for managing the entire IPO process — from due diligence and DRHP preparation, to filing with SEBI, setting the price band, managing book building, and coordinating the listing on BSE or NSE. They act as the primary intermediary between the issuer company and the investing public.

,

High subscription reflects investor demand, which is shaped by company fundamentals, valuation, grey market sentiment, and broader market conditions. A capable lead manager contributes to better price discovery and institutional interest. However, subscription numbers alone are not a reliable measure of lead manager quality — evaluate the issuer independently.

,

You can verify the SEBI registration of any merchant banker on the official SEBI website (sebi.gov.in) under the "Intermediaries/Market Infrastructure Institutions" section. All SEBI-registered merchant bankers are listed with their registration number, validity, and contact details.

]

short_bio:
[

The Ministry of Education, Science and Technology (MoEST) has officially published the complete list of educational consultancy institutions that have successfully completed their renewal process for fiscal year 2082/83.

,

The ministry has urged students and parents to carefully verify the specific services any given consultancy is authorised to provide before enrolling or paying fees. Approved services range widely across the sector:

,

Consultancy firms are simultaneously reminded that they may only operate within the scope of services for which they hold explicit approval. Operating outside approved service categories is a direct violation of MoEST regulations and may result in cancellation of registration.

,

The complete directory of renewed consultancies for FY 2082/83, along with the formal gazette notice and service-category breakdowns for each firm, is available on the official MoEST website. The issuing authority is the Educational Consultancy Certification Branch, Singha Durbar, Kathmandu.

,

Nepal sends tens of thousands of students abroad each year — primarily to Australia, Japan, Canada, the United States, and various European nations. The education consultancy sector has at times been marked by misinformation, unregistered operators, and excessive fee charging, making this official transparency measure especially significant for families navigating the process.

,

By publishing a verified roster of cleared firms, MoEST gives students a reliable reference point to cross-check before signing contracts or transferring money to any consultant claiming to offer overseas education services.

]

short_bio:
[

The Ministry of Education, Science and Technology (MoEST) has officially published the complete list of educational consultancy institutions that have successfully completed their renewal process for fiscal year 2082/83.

,

The ministry has urged students and parents to carefully verify the specific services any given consultancy is authorised to provide before enrolling or paying fees. Approved services range widely across the sector:

,

Consultancy firms are simultaneously reminded that they may only operate within the scope of services for which they hold explicit approval. Operating outside approved service categories is a direct violation of MoEST regulations and may result in cancellation of registration.

,

The complete directory of renewed consultancies for FY 2082/83, along with the formal gazette notice and service-category breakdowns for each firm, is available on the official MoEST website. The issuing authority is the Educational Consultancy Certification Branch, Singha Durbar, Kathmandu.

,

Nepal sends tens of thousands of students abroad each year — primarily to Australia, Japan, Canada, the United States, and various European nations. The education consultancy sector has at times been marked by misinformation, unregistered operators, and excessive fee charging, making this official transparency measure especially significant for families navigating the process.

,

By publishing a verified roster of cleared firms, MoEST gives students a reliable reference point to cross-check before signing contracts or transferring money to any consultant claiming to offer overseas education services.

]

name: Sabunam Educational Consultancy
short_bio:
[

The Ministry of Education, Science and Technology (MoEST) has officially published the complete list of educational consultancy institutions that have successfully completed their renewal process for fiscal year 2082/83.

,

The ministry has urged students and parents to carefully verify the specific services any given consultancy is authorised to provide before enrolling or paying fees. Approved services range widely across the sector:

,

Consultancy firms are simultaneously reminded that they may only operate within the scope of services for which they hold explicit approval. Operating outside approved service categories is a direct violation of MoEST regulations and may result in cancellation of registration.

,

The complete directory of renewed consultancies for FY 2082/83, along with the formal gazette notice and service-category breakdowns for each firm, is available on the official MoEST website. The issuing authority is the Educational Consultancy Certification Branch, Singha Durbar, Kathmandu.

,

Nepal sends tens of thousands of students abroad each year — primarily to Australia, Japan, Canada, the United States, and various European nations. The education consultancy sector has at times been marked by misinformation, unregistered operators, and excessive fee charging, making this official transparency measure especially significant for families navigating the process.

,

By publishing a verified roster of cleared firms, MoEST gives students a reliable reference point to cross-check before signing contracts or transferring money to any consultant claiming to offer overseas education services.

]

It is with great pride and commitment that I welcome you to our organization, a place where dreams of international education take shape and turn into reality. At Forbid Edu Career, we are driven by a singular mission: to provide ethical, personalized, and result-oriented guidance to every student who walks through our doors.

,

With a team of experienced counselors, strong partnerships with global institutions, and a passion for student success, we aim to open doors to quality education and brighter futures across the USA, UK, Australia, Japan, and beyond.

,

Mission forms the backbone of its organizational structure and service delivery. By emphasizing ethical, personalized, professional, and comprehensive educational counseling, the agency ensures that every service it offers is thoughtfully designed to support and enhance student success at every step of their journey.

To be the most trusted and sought-after education consultancy, renowned for our integrity, expertise, and unwavering commitment to student success. short_bio:
[

The Ministry of Education, Science and Technology (MoEST) has officially published the complete list of educational consultancy institutions that have successfully completed their renewal process for fiscal year 2082/83.

,

The ministry has urged students and parents to carefully verify the specific services any given consultancy is authorised to provide before enrolling or paying fees. Approved services range widely across the sector:

,

Consultancy firms are simultaneously reminded that they may only operate within the scope of services for which they hold explicit approval. Operating outside approved service categories is a direct violation of MoEST regulations and may result in cancellation of registration.

,

The complete directory of renewed consultancies for FY 2082/83, along with the formal gazette notice and service-category breakdowns for each firm, is available on the official MoEST website. The issuing authority is the Educational Consultancy Certification Branch, Singha Durbar, Kathmandu.

,

Nepal sends tens of thousands of students abroad each year — primarily to Australia, Japan, Canada, the United States, and various European nations. The education consultancy sector has at times been marked by misinformation, unregistered operators, and excessive fee charging, making this official transparency measure especially significant for families navigating the process.

,

By publishing a verified roster of cleared firms, MoEST gives students a reliable reference point to cross-check before signing contracts or transferring money to any consultant claiming to offer overseas education services.

]

,

The ministry has urged students and parents to carefully verify the specific services any given consultancy is authorised to provide before enrolling or paying fees. Approved services range widely across the sector:

,

Consultancy firms are simultaneously reminded that they may only operate within the scope of services for which they hold explicit approval. Operating outside approved service categories is a direct violation of MoEST regulations and may result in cancellation of registration.

,

The complete directory of renewed consultancies for FY 2082/83, along with the formal gazette notice and service-category breakdowns for each firm, is available on the official MoEST website. The issuing authority is the Educational Consultancy Certification Branch, Singha Durbar, Kathmandu.

,

,

At this school, I can contact a staff member at any time via chat, schedule extra private lessons, and meet with many different people from Japan. ,

,

I have been self-studying Japanese for many years and felt like I made very slow progress. Despite travelling to Japan multiple times for business and pleasure, I could still see there was many issues with my grammar and many things I did not understand. The teachers are friendly and fun and give you lots of opportunities to challenge yourself. Learning with Ohanasi has inspired me to apply for JLPT N4 test. I am confident I can pass it with their help.

,

I love studying Japanese with my Ohanasi teacher. It is a precious opportunity to work with native Japanese speakers who have a considered and measured approach to learning verb transformations, adjective forms and essential vocabulary. My teacher is patient, kind and understanding.
Japanese takes effort and time to learn and Ohanasi Japanese Language School exposes me to listening,
speaking, and applying language form to the vocabulary that I build throughout the course.
I appreciate having the option of scheduling self-study with the teacher so that I can review, ask questions about specific Japanese words or forms, or ask about Japanese culture or food!
In addition to a Language School, there is also Ohanasi Cafe, which gives me a chance to talk with native language speakers who are learning English and understand how hard it is to learn a language. It takes time and patience to make progress and Ohanasi Japanese Language School has given me confidence, understanding and hope that I will be able to speak with natives as long as I am diligent in my study and continue.


,

I realized that I could not communicate in Japanese at all when I see Japanese people in front of me and I felt that I needed a class.  My teacher is very positive and patient and teaches me until I fully understand.
I like the flexible style of the class, which allows me to do what I want to do, such as practicing reading books with my teacher outside of class as well as the regular private lessons.

,

I used to learn Japanese at another online school, but there was no curriculum and plan there, and I always dislike being asked by teacher what I wanted to do today.
I find Ohanasi Japanese Language School attractive because it has a structured curriculum and plan that covers the JLPT.

,

,

,

STATISTICS

,

2021.07.21 – 2022.06.24

,

HOW TO SIGN UP

,

In order to develop confidence in Japanese, let’s take a step forward in signing up for Ohanasi Japanese Language School

,

Find the best date and time for your trial lesson. You can easily book the trial lesson through our website.

,

You will have a trial lesson with one of our instructors. There, you will experience the actual class and see if you want to continue with it.

,

You will set up a curriculum and plan with the counselor. After that, you will also confirm your schedule with the instructor and start taking the course.

,

Schools offering Japanese language lessons range from low to high in price. Some of the platforms that only match freelance Japanese language instructors with students set the price low, while others set the price high. However, in many cases there is no clear course plan or curriculum, and it is left up to the individual teacher. Therefore, Japanese language instructors themselves often ask students what they want to do each time and proceed without a plan. Besides, the quality of the instructors and their teaching methods vary widely. In our school, all teachers use the same designed curriculum and teaching materials and follow the curriculum. Therefore, we are able to provide high quality lessons to every student without any differences in teaching methods from one teacher to another. The same curriculum and teaching materials can also be carried over in the event of a teacher change. Therefore, you will feel that the value of our services is more than the price of our services.

,

At our school, Japanese is taught by teachers who have completed our training. Therefore, our teachers have mastered our Japanese language teaching methods and understand the curriculum. Teachers are assigned to you and we will find a teacher who is a good match for you in the first few lessons. Even after a teacher is assigned to you, you can change teachers at any time if you want.

,

he reason we fix days and times is that we want our students to get into the habit of studying Japanese. By coming to the school on a certain day and time every week and studying with the teacher, studying Japanese becomes a part of your daily routine. However, if you are unable to attend a class because of an emergency, you can reschedule as many times as you wish by contacting the school or the teacher 3 hours in advance. Even if your teacher is not available, you can request an alternative teacher to teach your class, and the class will follow the same curriculum.

,

 As for payment, we use a subscription form of payment, which is deducted from your credit card on the first day of each month. We have our own membership page where you can make payments. You can also change your course or stop your subscription at any time from our membership page.

,

We want to create an environment that can support those who are studying Japanese with enthusiasm.

,

The Ohanasi Japanese Language School as it is today was born out of the many supportive experiences I received at my university in the United States.

,

I studied at a university in the U.S. with very little English and could not keep up with the classes at all, and many times I felt like I was going to fail.  
However, the people who supported me at those times were the Tutors, the teachers in the Writing Center, and the professors who helped me during office hours.

,

Having people who were kind enough to help me when I didn’t understand something gave me great emotional support, and I was able to achieve my goals without falling behind.

,

I always try to be close to my students so that I can create a school that is the world’s most supportive and can support those who are trying their best to study Japanese.

,

Ohanasi Japanese Language School
Chairman

,

for those who book a school enrollment orientation within 3 days of the end of the trial lesson!

short_bio:
[

Ample Education has helped students secure top university admissions, win scholarships, and excel in exams shaping bright futures with expert guidance.

,

Not sure which course or career path to choose? Our expert counselors assess your interests, skills, and future job market trends to guide you toward the best educational opportunities.

,

Our career counseling includes personalized assessment tests, one-on-one sessions with industry professionals, and comprehensive reports that map out potential career trajectories. We analyze current job market demands and future trends to ensure your educational investment pays off in the long run.

,

Our study abroad consultants have direct relationships with over 500 universities worldwide. We provide country-specific guidance on education systems, living costs, work opportunities, and immigration policies. Our service includes ROI analysis for different countries and programs to help you make an informed decision.

,

Our test prep programs feature small batch sizes with instructors who scored in the top 1% of their respective exams. We offer customized study plans, weekly practice tests, and detailed performance analytics. Our students improve their scores by an average of 15-20% after completing our programs.

,

We collaborate with the UK's leading universities to provide researchers, educators, and students with exceptional academic and research opportunities. The UK is home to 4 of the world's top 6 universities and 19 of the top 100 universities globally, according to QS World Rankings. Among these, a select group of research-focused institutions forms the prestigious Russell Group, representing the pinnacle of academic excellence. Whether you aim to pursue higher education, professional courses, or research programs, we connect you with the best universities in the UK, including QA Higher Education, Oxford, and other top institutions.

,

Ample Education empowers students with expert guidance for university admissions, scholarships, and test prep, ensuring a smooth academic journey and a brighter future through personalized education consulting.

name: Plan International Education Consultancy Company P. Ltd
short_bio:
[

The Ministry of Education, Science and Technology (MoEST) has officially published the complete list of educational consultancy institutions that have successfully completed their renewal process for fiscal year 2082/83.

,

The ministry has urged students and parents to carefully verify the specific services any given consultancy is authorised to provide before enrolling or paying fees. Approved services range widely across the sector:

,

Consultancy firms are simultaneously reminded that they may only operate within the scope of services for which they hold explicit approval. Operating outside approved service categories is a direct violation of MoEST regulations and may result in cancellation of registration.

,

The complete directory of renewed consultancies for FY 2082/83, along with the formal gazette notice and service-category breakdowns for each firm, is available on the official MoEST website. The issuing authority is the Educational Consultancy Certification Branch, Singha Durbar, Kathmandu.

,

Nepal sends tens of thousands of students abroad each year — primarily to Australia, Japan, Canada, the United States, and various European nations. The education consultancy sector has at times been marked by misinformation, unregistered operators, and excessive fee charging, making this official transparency measure especially significant for families navigating the process.

,

By publishing a verified roster of cleared firms, MoEST gives students a reliable reference point to cross-check before signing contracts or transferring money to any consultant claiming to offer overseas education services.

]

Committed to holistic development through education, mental health, digital literacy, and financial literacy. Dedicated to building an empowered, aware, and self-reliant society.

,

In today’s rapidly changing world, digital skills, mental well-being, and financial awareness are as essential as education itself. To address these needs, we design and implement impactful initiatives focused on education, digital literacy, mental health, and life skills development.

,

For us, every beneficiary represents a dream, a future, and an opportunity for transformation. Through education we create hope, through technology we open opportunities, and through social unity we build a brighter future.

,

Identifying the critical barriers that prevent marginalized children from accessing continuous and quality education.

,

Through education, technology, mental resilience, financial literacy, and cyber safety, we empower individuals to become confident, capable, and future-ready.

,

We target urban slum communities that have a high concentration of at-risk children with limited access to educational support.

Be a part of the change! Support education, skill development, and social welfare. Together, we can create a better future.

Your contribution empowers education, skill development, and social welfare for those in need. Give today and change a life!

,

Join us in creating lasting impact through education and social change. Partner with us to make a difference!

The Ministry of Education, Science and Technology (MoEST) has officially published the complete list of educational consultancy institutions that have successfully completed their renewal process for fiscal year 2082/83.

,

The ministry has urged students and parents to carefully verify the specific services any given consultancy is authorised to provide before enrolling or paying fees. Approved services range widely across the sector:

,

Consultancy firms are simultaneously reminded that they may only operate within the scope of services for which they hold explicit approval. Operating outside approved service categories is a direct violation of MoEST regulations and may result in cancellation of registration.

,

The complete directory of renewed consultancies for FY 2082/83, along with the formal gazette notice and service-category breakdowns for each firm, is available on the official MoEST website. The issuing authority is the Educational Consultancy Certification Branch, Singha Durbar, Kathmandu.

,

Nepal sends tens of thousands of students abroad each year — primarily to Australia, Japan, Canada, the United States, and various European nations. The education consultancy sector has at times been marked by misinformation, unregistered operators, and excessive fee charging, making this official transparency measure especially significant for families navigating the process.

,

By publishing a verified roster of cleared firms, MoEST gives students a reliable reference point to cross-check before signing contracts or transferring money to any consultant claiming to offer overseas education services.

]

name: Texas Education academy
short_bio:
[

 Your Gateway to a World-Class Education in Japan:

,

WELCOME TO TEXAS EDUCATION ACADEMY

,

Currently, many students are aiming for abroad among them Japan is one of the top most choice. Nowadays, Japan is becoming more and more popular education destination country. Our School is providing this opportunity by helping these students by teaching Japanese Language as well as assisting them to search the best Japanese Language schools, Technical Colleges and Universities in Japan for their further study. However, I would like to mention that without the knowledge of Japanese Language the life in Japan is almost impossible. Also, you have to be more disciplined, more punctual and obedient in your study as well as work to be a successful in Japan. You have to follow every rules and regulation strictly there.

,

 WHY TEXAS EDUCATION ACADEMY?

,

Studying in Japan from Nepal presents a range of advantages. Students gain access to top-notch education, cutting-edge research facilities, and industry collaboration, contributing to a well-rounded academic experience. Immersing in Japan’s vibrant culture and diverse society enhances personal growth and prepares students for a globalized future. Moreover, the availability of scholarships and support systems makes Japan an appealing choice for Nepalese students.

,

We are delighted to witness your interest in pursuing education in Japan, and our academy is fully committed to supporting you in this endeavor. Through our Japanese language courses and dedicated assistance in finding the right educational institutions, we aim to equip you for success. However, it’s important to note that proficiency in Japanese is essential for a fulfilling life in Japan, and adherence to discipline, punctuality, and obedience to rules will pave the way for a successful journey. Embrace this opportunity with enthusiasm, and we will be there to guide you throughout.

,

Texas Education Academy has provided me with an educational environment that fosters growth, nurtures curiosity, and encourages collaboration. The dedicated and passionate educators here go above and beyond to ensure that each student receives personalized attention and support. They inspire us to dream big, to set ambitious goals, and to believe in our ability to achieve them.

,

One of the standout features of Texas Education Academy is its commitment to academic excellence. The rigorous curriculum challenges students to think critically, analyze complex problems, and develop innovative solutions. The school’s emphasis on STEM subjects has fueled my passion for science and technology, equipping me with the skills and knowledge needed to excel in these fields.

,

Beyond academic excellence, Texas Education Academy understands the importance of holistic development. The school offers a wide range of extracurricular activities, clubs, and sports programs that cater to diverse interests. These opportunities have allowed me to explore my passions, develop leadership skills, and form lifelong friendships with fellow students who share similar aspirations.

,

Want to know more about study in Japan?

]
