name: Nanzan Inernational Language Institute Pvt.Ltd.
short_bio:
[

Experience top-tier Japanese language education and practical application support at our state-of-the-art consultancy.

,

Our consultancy ensures a smooth journey to Japan with a proven track record of high success rates in study and work placements.

,

Nanzan International Language Institute, located in Putalisadak, Kathmandu, is a prominent Japanese consultancy focused on bridging the language and cultural gap between Nepal and Japan. The institute offers various Japanese courses for all levels, enhancing skills in speaking, reading, writing, and listening while providing insights into Japanese culture. Additionally, Nanzan provides consultancy services for individuals interested in studying or working in Japan, assisting with applications, visa requirements, and career advice. By fostering a deeper understanding of the Japanese language and culture, the institute plays a crucial role in facilitating cultural exchange and connecting Nepali students with Japan.

,

Over 15 years of experience in language education.

,

Dr Bikalpa Bikash Neupane (citizen of Nepal) is currently Head of AI and NLP at Takeda. As an emerging international leader in the field of artificial intelligence (AI) and software engineering, Dr. Neupane is passionate about advancing the frontiers of technology in developing countries. Having earned his Ph.D. from the prestigious Penn State University in the United States, Dr Neupane has a track record of releasing and managing cutting-edge software at tech giants such as Microsoft, Overstock, and IBM Watson. He's received several recognitions from the United Nations and The World Bank. Dr Neupane teaches graduate level courses in computing and data science disciplines at several US universities and serves as a board member, advisor, and mentor to various technology startups in the USA and internationally.

]

name: Sayuri International Education Pvt. Ltd.
short_bio:
[

The Ministry of Education, Science and Technology (MoEST) has officially published the complete list of educational consultancy institutions that have successfully completed their renewal process for fiscal year 2082/83.

,

The ministry has urged students and parents to carefully verify the specific services any given consultancy is authorised to provide before enrolling or paying fees. Approved services range widely across the sector:

,

Consultancy firms are simultaneously reminded that they may only operate within the scope of services for which they hold explicit approval. Operating outside approved service categories is a direct violation of MoEST regulations and may result in cancellation of registration.

,

The complete directory of renewed consultancies for FY 2082/83, along with the formal gazette notice and service-category breakdowns for each firm, is available on the official MoEST website. The issuing authority is the Educational Consultancy Certification Branch, Singha Durbar, Kathmandu.

,

Nepal sends tens of thousands of students abroad each year — primarily to Australia, Japan, Canada, the United States, and various European nations. The education consultancy sector has at times been marked by misinformation, unregistered operators, and excessive fee charging, making this official transparency measure especially significant for families navigating the process.

,

By publishing a verified roster of cleared firms, MoEST gives students a reliable reference point to cross-check before signing contracts or transferring money to any consultant claiming to offer overseas education services.

]

name: Evolve Education Group Nepal Pvt.Ltd.
short_bio:
[

The Ministry of Education, Science and Technology (MoEST) has officially published the complete list of educational consultancy institutions that have successfully completed their renewal process for fiscal year 2082/83.

,

The ministry has urged students and parents to carefully verify the specific services any given consultancy is authorised to provide before enrolling or paying fees. Approved services range widely across the sector:

,

Consultancy firms are simultaneously reminded that they may only operate within the scope of services for which they hold explicit approval. Operating outside approved service categories is a direct violation of MoEST regulations and may result in cancellation of registration.

,

The complete directory of renewed consultancies for FY 2082/83, along with the formal gazette notice and service-category breakdowns for each firm, is available on the official MoEST website. The issuing authority is the Educational Consultancy Certification Branch, Singha Durbar, Kathmandu.

,

Nepal sends tens of thousands of students abroad each year — primarily to Australia, Japan, Canada, the United States, and various European nations. The education consultancy sector has at times been marked by misinformation, unregistered operators, and excessive fee charging, making this official transparency measure especially significant for families navigating the process.

,

By publishing a verified roster of cleared firms, MoEST gives students a reliable reference point to cross-check before signing contracts or transferring money to any consultant claiming to offer overseas education services.

]

If you’re thinking of launching an overseas education consultancy in Southeast Asia (SEA) a few years ago, your first concern was likely connections.

,

The outside view of the international education industry is complex. Students are applying to various countries, universities have different admission processes, visa requirements are constantly changing, and there is a lot of competition.

,

This is why more and more people are considering launching education consultancy Southeast Asia businesses, particularly in Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia, and the Philippines, where outbound student mobility is rapidly increasing each year.

,

When one looks at the situation of families in the past decade in the Southeast Asian region, the clear message is that families invest in education in a different way today.

,

Previously, studying abroad was considered to be an option for only affluent students. In Vietnam, Indonesia, and the Philippines, middle-class families are now actively preparing for overseas education options for their children.

,

These have gained tremendous popularity as students now view them as investments for their future careers rather than just places of education.

,

Vietnam, in particular, has emerged as one of the most powerful outbound markets in Southeast Asia. Many families there value international education as they feel that international degrees provide more career stability.

,

In the meantime, Indonesia and Malaysia are still churning out massive cohorts of students who are looking for overseas education opportunities on a regular intake season.

,

This is the reason why the overseas education business in the SEA market continues to grow annually.

,

The great news is that many Southeast Asian nations don’t have a complicated licensing process to begin an educational consulting company.

,

A lot of people assume education agencies earn only through university commissions.

,

The Ministry of Education, Science and Technology (MoEST) has officially published the complete list of educational consultancy institutions that have successfully completed their renewal process for fiscal year 2082/83.

,

The ministry has urged students and parents to carefully verify the specific services any given consultancy is authorised to provide before enrolling or paying fees. Approved services range widely across the sector:

,

Consultancy firms are simultaneously reminded that they may only operate within the scope of services for which they hold explicit approval. Operating outside approved service categories is a direct violation of MoEST regulations and may result in cancellation of registration.

,

The complete directory of renewed consultancies for FY 2082/83, along with the formal gazette notice and service-category breakdowns for each firm, is available on the official MoEST website. The issuing authority is the Educational Consultancy Certification Branch, Singha Durbar, Kathmandu.

,

Nepal sends tens of thousands of students abroad each year — primarily to Australia, Japan, Canada, the United States, and various European nations. The education consultancy sector has at times been marked by misinformation, unregistered operators, and excessive fee charging, making this official transparency measure especially significant for families navigating the process.

,

By publishing a verified roster of cleared firms, MoEST gives students a reliable reference point to cross-check before signing contracts or transferring money to any consultant claiming to offer overseas education services.

]

The United Kingdom has long been a sought-after destination for international students, offering world-class education and a multicultural environment. However, recent policy changes have altered the rights of these students to bring their dependents with them.

,

On May 23, 2023, the Home Secretary announced a significant policy change that directly impacts international students and their families. In line with the government’s commitment to reduce net migration numbers, this change aims to revise the regulations concerning dependents accompanying international students.

,

This policy shift signifies a renewed focus on maintaining tighter control over immigration numbers while also acknowledging the importance of supporting international students in their educational pursuits. It is crucial to understand the implications of this change for both current and prospective international students who aspire to study in the United Kingdom.

,

The UK government has implemented a significant change regarding international students’ ability to switch from the student route to work routes before completing their studies. This policy adjustment means that international students will no longer have the option to transition into work routes while still pursuing their education in the UK.

,

It is important for prospective international students planning to study in the UK or those currently enrolled in educational institutions to be aware of this change in immigration rules. This alteration may impact their future career plans and require them to complete their studies before seeking employment opportunities within the country.

,

It is advisable for individuals affected by this change to consult with educational institutions and immigration experts for further guidance on how it may specifically impact their circumstances.

The Ministry of Education, Science and Technology (MoEST) has officially published the complete list of educational consultancy institutions that have successfully completed their renewal process for fiscal year 2082/83.

,

The ministry has urged students and parents to carefully verify the specific services any given consultancy is authorised to provide before enrolling or paying fees. Approved services range widely across the sector:

,

Consultancy firms are simultaneously reminded that they may only operate within the scope of services for which they hold explicit approval. Operating outside approved service categories is a direct violation of MoEST regulations and may result in cancellation of registration.

,

The complete directory of renewed consultancies for FY 2082/83, along with the formal gazette notice and service-category breakdowns for each firm, is available on the official MoEST website. The issuing authority is the Educational Consultancy Certification Branch, Singha Durbar, Kathmandu.

,

Nepal sends tens of thousands of students abroad each year — primarily to Australia, Japan, Canada, the United States, and various European nations. The education consultancy sector has at times been marked by misinformation, unregistered operators, and excessive fee charging, making this official transparency measure especially significant for families navigating the process.

,

By publishing a verified roster of cleared firms, MoEST gives students a reliable reference point to cross-check before signing contracts or transferring money to any consultant claiming to offer overseas education services.

]

name: FOUR STEPS CONSULTANCY
short_bio:
[

Pahan Chhen is a newly restored historic hotel located right outside the premises of the UNESCO enlisted Patan Durbar Square (Ancient royal palace of Patan) followed by various other historical monuments and renowned handicraft market.

,

In traditional local Newari language, “PAHAN” means “Guest” and “CHHEN” means “Home”. Nepal is one of the many countries which has a culture and tradition to treat guest like God. Therefore, when someone visit our home, we treat them with love, respect and we make sure they are well fed. The tradition has been passed down to us from generation to generation for hundreds of years and we will continue to do so. That’s our culture and it brings us great pleasure and happiness .

,

The vision behind the boutique hotel is to construct a historical and culturally compelling atmosphere offering professional, personalized and flexible hospitality services. Therefore, building is made with brick walls, traditional terracotta-tiled floors, wooden beams and windows precisely handcrafted by local craftsmen in the traditional Newari style.

,

With our comfortable cosy hotel rooms, remarkable hotel service and diversified facilities, we make every effort to ensure you enjoy the stay. We offer breakfast, lunch or dinner in a casual and relaxed atmosphere in the hotel restaurant or you can enjoy your food at our rooftop terrace with amazing panoramic view of the Himalayas, Patan Durbar Square and the City. Our room facilities include free Wi-Fi, flat screen television, air conditioning, attached bathroom with basic toiletries and more.

,

Mangal Bazaar 12,
Patan Durbar Square,
Lalitpur,
Nepal.

,
